description: This file defines common structures, function pointer types, and macros for the COSA API layer, including object base structures, context link objects, and list management functions.

methods.name: CosaSListPushEntryByInsNum
methods.description: Pushes a context link object into a list based on instance number.

methods.name: CosaSListGetEntryByInsNum
methods.description: Retrieves a context link object from a list by instance number.
